scope: Shared cancellation checks at borrowed/owned scan advancement and completion
evidence: Delayed no-output scanner cancellation rejects and releases retained slice manifest
Owned values allocated after cancellation are discarded before handoff and release all reservations
Cancellation while a consumer holds a value prevents another source advancement
Early consumer return closes source without discarding handed-off values
No configured signal returns the original iterable without another async-generator layer
limits: In-flight I/O is awaited, not forcibly interrupted
This does not close object discovery or returned output ownership
Runtime headroom and final release gates remain open
